records.name: Illusive Clone
records.note: 90s cd; removes Heart Gore cooldown + 20% extra damage for 10s (L1) / 30s (max). Specialties at stigma Lv 5/10/15/20.
notes: maxLevel 40: Metabot skill pages only. Metabot's own Ranger class page says 25, and Kanon's Aion 2 Bible (KR, owner upload) gives 20, then 25 with Superior shards after Lv 50: disputed (Game Data Check, 2026-10-21). A leveling guide does not reach it and the app does not show it, so no owner check is asked.
